firstPlayerRule: Whoever saw a lynx most recently takes the paw marker and plays first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Play continues clockwise. The two-player variant retains this base-game starting instruction.
